evidence.R1-05: round0 SG-01 "a repeated refund call for an order returns the same refund id and never creates a second refund" (and CO-S16 row 2, where a timed-out first call that created RF-5531 makes the second call return RF-5531) means a second ProviderUnavailable implies no refund exists, so "the refund has not been issued" is true and the feared case cannot occur.
evidence.R1-06: round0 CO-S06 Forbidden "CO-A3 at any point." with §5.1 "Event lines ... are evaluated on occurrences, never on effects" fails a wrongful refund call whatever its effect; CO-01/CO-05 have holding-back scenarios (CO-S05, CO-S06, CO-S11), so the no-refund cancelled state is an extra variant, i.e. "one more scenario would be nice".
evidence.R1-09: round0 failure row "the order system ... did not answer it | Make CO-A3 once more, relying on SG-01" and packet case 3 "agent retries once, then re-reads" make the second CO-A3 mandatory, so the agent that skips it fails unambiguously; the count asserts required behavior, not an optional path.
evidence.R3-03: round2 CO-S03 row 4 "Yes, go ahead. Actually no, wait, make it HG-10511 instead." triggers the changed-proposal row with a yes that carries a change, and CO-S09 covers the payment-method refusal; a scenario per disjunct is "one more scenario would be nice".
evidence.R3-06: round2 §5.2 "A rubric judge reads every text the agent sends, including text sent alongside a tool call" plus the clause "says store staff will follow up only in a message sent after the order system returned the follow-up task": narration beside CO-A4 is not such a message under either reading of "message", so both readings fail it; "never says ... that staff will follow up" in Staff contact unconfirmed reported likewise covers narration.
evidence.R3-08: round2 "Refund not confirmed reported" requires "the refund is not confirmed yet" and excludes only "pending or issued"; for CO-S20 row 1 (lookup shows RF-5531 failed) G-03 directs "tells the customer the action was not done", and since §5.2 "Each judge grades one dimension" the separately named "Refund not issued reported" does not reach this judge, so whether "your refund failed / has not been issued" meets "not confirmed yet" is left to the judge.
